articles.title: Ex-Trump crypto adviser profited after helping pass stablecoin bill: WSJ
articles.snippet: The Wall Street Journal reported that a company co-founded by Bo Hines benefited from the passage of the GENIUS stablecoin bill.

articles.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
articles.snippet: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

articles.title: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments
articles.snippet: The launch of Global Money Platform marks Mastercard’s first major integration with BVNK since its August acquisition, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first companies to adopt the platform.

articles.title: EU authority classifies Circle’s USDC as ‘significant’ under MiCA
articles.snippet: The second-largest stablecoin by market cap will be overseen by French and EU authorities under its classification as a “significant e-money token.“

articles.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2T stablecoin forecast to 2030 as transaction volumes grow
articles.snippet: The bank identified four distinct stablecoin markets, with USDC leading payments and AI transactions as competition intensifies over reserve yields.
